intro: The Empty Water Tube is a simple glass vessel provided in Auberdine to collect sacred moonwell water. It is meant to carry the blessed liquid up to the strange red crystal perched on the eastern cliffs of Darkshore.

p: Sentinels and scholars studying the mysterious red crystal along Darkshore's eastern ridge require pure lunar essence to test its nature. Because mundane glass or flasks can easily contaminate consecrated water, this sealed vial is specifically entrusted to investigators visiting the moonwell in Auberdine. Once filled, its contents are carried up the mountain slopes to see how the alien mineral responds to Elune's magic.
